products.title: Enjoy The Little Things Hoodie
products.body_html:
An oversized brushed-fleece hoodie in ice white, printed across the back panel in retro blue. No chest logo — one line worth repeating.

Dropped shoulders, deep ribbed cuffs and hem, and a lined hood. 100% polyester brushed fleece; a size M weighs approximately 320 g. Polyester is chosen for easy care: it dries quickly, resists shrinkage when washed as directed and helps the ice-white fabric and blue print retain their colour.

Find your size in one minute

This hoodie is cut oversized on purpose — roomy through the chest, dropped shoulders, deep ribbed cuffs. That also means the fit forgives. Most people are comfortable in more than one size, so you are not choosing on a knife edge.

Two things to know before you pick. The sizes are Asian, so they run one to two sizes smaller than an EU or US label — do not order by your usual letter. And the range splits into two lengths: XS to XL have a shorter body (63–68 cm), while 2XL to 4XL are longer (75.5–78.5 cm).

The one-minute method. Take a hoodie you already wear and like. Lay it flat and measure it pit to pit. Pick the length you want from the two groups above, then match that pit-to-pit figure against the Bust column in the size chart on this page. That is your size. All measurements are in centimetres, taken flat, and approximate.

Want a second opinion? Send those measurements to hello@goodmessagestudio.com and we will confirm which size we would post you. It is there if you want it — the size chart on this page is enough on its own.

Delivery to Singapore

Expected delivery: 5–8 business days — free and tracked, with no minimum spend. Orders are prepared in 1–4 business days, and tracked transit normally takes 4–8 days after dispatch; you receive a tracking number as soon as your parcel leaves. During peak periods, customs checks or carrier disruption, allow up to 13 days. These are estimates, not guaranteed dates.

If it arrives damaged, incorrect or not as described, Singapore Lemon Law remedies apply at no cost to you — email us with your order number and clear photos or a short video. Change-of-mind returns and exchanges are not accepted, which is why every measurement is published above. Cold machine wash inside out on a gentle cycle; line dry in shade; do not tumble dry or iron directly on the print.
